module: Driving Dynamics Suite actuator: variable-stiffness torsion bars (anti-roll). It groups torsion bars by name and, according to a named mode, applies multiplicative coefficients to their jbeam stiffness and damping via `obj:setTorsionbarSpringDamp`. The mode is chosen with `setParameters({torsionBarMode = "name"})`, typically from a `driveModes` mode of type "controller". Call order: `defaultOrder = 80`.
notes: jbeam keys read by init: `torsionBarNames` (list of jbeam bar names), `modes` (header table: `name`, `springCoef`, `dampCoef`, 1 by default), `name`.
The coefficients multiply the base values of `v.data.torsionbars` (spring, damp): the change is not cumulative from one mode to the next.
No periodic update; an unknown mode name is logged as an error. `shutdown` sets isActive to false and removes update/updateGFX (nil) without restoring the base values.

isActing.desc: false: never modified in this file.

reset.desc: Empty (the bars are not restored to their initial state).

init.desc: Finds the torsion bars by name and reads the modes.

registerCMU.desc: Called by the CMU to give it a reference to itself.

setDebugMode.desc: Stores the debug mode (no other effect).

setParameters.desc: Applies a stiffness mode if `parameters.torsionBarMode` is provided.

parameters.desc: Field: torsionBarMode (name of a mode defined in `modes`).

setConfig.desc: Replaces the parameter table (no effect on the modes).

getConfig.desc: Returns a copy of the parameters.

sendConfigData.desc: Sends the parameters to the CMU in a config debug packet.
